nom: Peter Thomas Roth Instant FIRMx Glow-Filter Priming Serum

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin generally report the serum does not increase greasiness and gives a hydrated rather than shiny finish, though one reviewer felt it made little visible difference to her oily finish.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or very dry skin describe the product as hydrating and moisturizing, saying it leaves skin looking moist, supple and glowy rather than dry.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it works well as a primer, holds makeup without causing breakouts, and does not feel heavy.
segments.sensitive: One reviewer describing pore-clogging and breakout-prone/sensitive skin reports no pimples or clogged pores after use.
segments.normal: A reviewer with normal skin found it absorbed well as part of her regular skincare and primer routine without pilling.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 50s and 60s report a lifted, firmer appearance and reduced look of fine lines, with one calling it the best product for mature skin she has tried.

concerns.aging: Several mature reviewers report a lifted, firmer, more sculpted look and reduced visibility of fine lines over time; some say the firming effect is subtle or not yet noticeable after only a couple of weeks, and one reviewer found no lifting at all after two months.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers, including those with dry skin, report the serum leaves skin feeling hydrated, soft and plump rather than dry.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports it covers up redness and evens out skin tone; this is not widely discussed by others.
concerns.barrier: Not enough reviewers discuss barrier-specific effects to draw a conclusion.
concerns.spots: A couple of reviewers note it minimizes the visibility of dark spots and discoloration, giving a more even-toned complexion.
concerns.blemishes: One detailed reviewer with acne-prone skin reports no clogged pores or new pimples from this product, describing it as pore-friendly; no other reviewer reports breakouts from use.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers, including several who identify as oily or combination, say the finish is not greasy or shiny in an oily way; one reviewer with oily skin felt it made little difference to oil control.

aspects.libelle: Extends makeup wear and blurs pores

extraits.texte: Gifted by Peter Thomas Roth in exchange for my honest feedback. I was hopeful that this would run a bit more neutral, but it is still too orange/red for my very cool olive, light-medium skin tone. However, the tint is quite sheer, and I can still get away with it if I want. The finish isn't greasy. I have pretty oily skin, and I felt that this did not make much of a difference in the finish of my skin. I was still glowy, but my skin did look less 'greasy' and more 'hydrated.' The finish felt nice on my skin and left a nice primed surface. This primer is like a very nice moisturizer type primer (rather than a sticky or silicone finish primer). I did not notice much blurring, but my skin did look more hydrated and less textured. I think someone with dry skin would appreciate the finish of this product more than I do, although I think even on dry skin the glow from the product would be quite subtle and natural looking. This is not going to look like you are putting highlighter on your face. There isn't really any glitter once you apply the product. In the tube, it looks shimmery, even glittery, but I don't see any of that once it's on my skin. Also, I don't detect any fragrance. It doesn't really smell like anything, maybe a little fresh and clean? I think this product would be most appreciated by someone with normal to dry skin and a neutral to warm undertone.

Absolutely love this serum. It glides onto my skin with ease and gives it an instant glow. It hydrates my super dry skin and leaves it looking moist and supple. The smell is my only issue. I do not like how it smells. Gifted by peterthomasroth

extraits.titre: Must have for a glowing complexion
extraits.texte: As a long-time user of various skincare and makeup products, I have finally found a gem in the Instant Firm Glow Filter Priming Serum gifted by peterthomasroth.This product has completely transformed my daily routine, and I couldn't be happier with the results. **Appearance and Texture**: The serum itself has a lightweight, non-greasy texture that glides effortlessly onto the skin. Unlike other primers or foundations, it doesn't feel heavy or cakey, and it leaves my skin feeling breathable and fresh. **Tint and Coverage**: One of the standout features of this priming serum is its subtle tint, which provides just enough coverage to even out my skin tone without masking my natural complexion. I often wear it alone without any additional base, and it gives me a flawless, natural look. The tint is perfect for those who prefer a more minimalist approach to makeup. **Pore-Friendly Formula**: Having struggled with products that clog my pores and lead to breakouts, I was delighted to find that this serum does the opposite. It smooths out my skin without sinking into pores or creating pimples. This is a huge plus for anyone with sensitive or acne-prone skin. **Glow and Finish**: The glow this serum provides is truly remarkable. It gives my skin a radiant, healthy appearance, making me look awake and refreshed, even on the most tiring days. The luminous finish is enough to give me a confident, awake look without the need for additional highlighters or illuminators. **Overall Performanc

I'm almost 56. I've used several different brand over the years. This is absolutely THE best for mature skin I've tried. I hope they never stop making it. I love it so much I'm going to try their other products.

I tried the Peter Thomas Roth Instant FirmX® Glow-Filter Primer from ULTA and loved it. It instantly tightened my skin and gave it a healthy glow. The lightweight texture blended easily, blurred imperfections, and provided a smooth base for my makeup. It worked well with my combination skin without causing breakouts. Highly recommend! gifted by thomasroth

I've seen SO many TikTok videos of Peter Thomas Roth products that have been AMAZING so I was so excited to try out this Peter Thomas Roth Instant Firm Glow Filter Priming Serum. But wow, what a letdown! This does NOT do what their "viral" products claim to do. This does not instantly FIRM at all! Nor does it blur my pores! All it does is leave a glowy ORANGE tint to my skin - which actually enhances the look of my pores. If you're looking for a primer to help blur your pores, this is NOT it. If you're looking for a primer to give your skin a heavy GLOW, then you may like this. Personally, I'm super disappointed. GiftedbyPeterThomasRoth

I've been using this primer for a while now, and it's fantastic! It makes my skin look smooth and even, instantly blurring my pores and smoothing my cheeks. My fine lines, especially on my forehead, are much less noticeable. It effectively covers up blemishes and redness, giving my skin an even tone and texture. complimentary from peter thomas roth
